info.name: Google Tag Manager Accounts Tagmanager API

description.content:
The Google Tag Manager API v2 allows clients to access and modify Google Tag Manager account, container, workspace, tag, trigger, and variable configurations. It provides programmatic management of tag deployment, trigger conditions, and variable definitions across web, mobile, and server-side containers.
